_about: HAND-AUTHORED SYNTHETIC FIXTURE for GSVTK_ENTITY_JSON (see the placeholder rule in
checkinputs-GenotypeBatch-config.json). The shape is what `terra.entity_sample()` answers
(`workspace`: {namespace, name, attributes}) -- deliberately the shapes the LIVE readers return,
so the capture format survives the integration request that replaces this lane's page walk with a
point read: a capture taken with `fiss get_entity` or a page of `entityQuery` drops straight in.
Three states, three different attribute names, so a leg can assert a literal count on each:
PRESENT (5 row + 3 workspace), PRESENT-EMPTY (`median_cov_frz`, an empty string on the row),
ABSENT (2 row + 1 workspace). `genotyped_depth_vcf_new` is an output of this step and is NOT one of
its references: it is here so a leg can see the check grading the references and not the set-diff
of two attribute lists. EXAMPLE_SET_B exists so a leg can see the lookup is keyed by row NAME.

entities._about: the SAME references, on a row that carries all eight of them: --entity EXAMPLE_SET_B grades absent=1 where EXAMPLE_SET_A grades absent=3, which is the leg that proves the row NAME is load-bearing and not an illustrative label on the line
